name: PhotoRestore AI
description:
## About PhotoRestore AI

PhotoRestore AI combines cutting-edge artificial intelligence with a passion for preserving memories. We believe every photo tells a story, and no damage should stand in the way of sharing those precious moments.

### Our Technology

Built on state-of-the-art machine learning models, PhotoRestore AI can detect and repair scratches, tears, and creases; restore faded or discolored areas; enhance image clarity and sharpness; colorize black & white photographs; and remove stains and water damage.

### Privacy First

We take your privacy seriously. All photos are processed in isolated secure environments and automatically deleted within 24 hours of processing. Your memories stay yours.

## Try It Today

Experience the magic of AI photo restoration. Upload your damaged photo and see the transformation in seconds.

faq.question: How does the AI restoration work?
faq.answer: Our AI analyzes your photo to detect damage, fading, and imperfections, then intelligently restores the image using trained neural networks.

faq.question: Is my photo data secure?
faq.answer: Absolutely. All uploaded photos are processed securely and automatically deleted after 24 hours. We never store or share your images.

faq.question: What types of damage can be fixed?
faq.answer: Our AI can restore faded colors, fix scratches and tears, remove stains, enhance clarity, and even colorize black & white photos.

faq.question: How much does it cost?
faq.answer: We offer flexible pricing starting from $2 per photo. Bulk packages are available for larger restoration projects.
